messages:
nina: Hi team, first week here! Quick security onboarding questions 1) where do I find the mandatory security training (can't find it in the welcome email) 2) my company laptop is delayed, should I enroll my personal laptop in MDM to get access faster?
harry (People Ops): Welcome Nina! :tada: Training is in the LMS Security Foundations (SSO). If the link in the email is blank for you I'll resend. You have 7 days to complete it.
mira (InfoSec): Do not enroll personal devices into MDM unless IT says so. We only push MDM to company-provided machines. For now use 1Password (work vault) and enable 2FA.
nina: Got a blank link, thanks Harry. Also saw a note about a phishing exercise next week 1 is that required?
security-bot: Alert: Phishing simulation (cohort D) runs next Wed at 10:00. Participation is mandatory as part of the Security Foundations curriculum. Failures prompt a short refresher module.
mira (InfoSec): It's purely educational. If you report a simulated phish, great. If you clicked and entered creds, rotate the password and DM InfoSec immediately.
it-support (devon): If you need early access, DM me with your order number. We'll provide VPN creds and a temporary service account without asking you to enroll personal hardware.
oliver (manager): Hi Nina  welcome! I'll give you repo access today. Ping me if the VPN or tickets block you and we can do a quick screen share.
nina: Thanks all. Harry, can you resend the LMS link? Also, should I always use VPN on public Wi-Fi before the company laptop arrives?
harry (People Ops): Resent the LMS invite to nina@redwood.com.
mira (InfoSec): Yes, always use the company VPN on public or untrusted networks. KB: https://redwood-internal.kb/security/vpn-setup. If you have trouble connecting DM @devon.
nina: Got the LMS link and the VPN setup worked. Thanks everyone! Marking this resolved unless other questions come up. :smile:
